statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low while macro Stress remains extreme.
recommendation: The public state is green; the main conditional risk window is the PPI/claims-to-cash-open sequence from 12:15 to 14:30 UTC.
headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress before U.S. producer-price data
body: The freshest delayed NQ page shows 29,467 within a narrow 29,461.50-29,469.00 range, slightly above the prior close. Brent remains above $100 and the 10-year Treasury yield near 4.84%. The observed price path does not show persistent one-way extension; PPI and claims at 12:30 UTC are the next major checkpoint.

lookbackSummary: Published ChatGPT assessments show Tail peaking at 43% during the September 9 downside episode, then falling back below the blocking threshold as the path became mixed through the U.S. afternoon and overnight. The September 9 12:00 UTC slot remains unavailable.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours carry extreme macro Stress from energy, yields and U.S. inflation-event risk. Tail stays below the block threshold in the base case; any increase is conditional on post-PPI or cash-open persistent extension, shallow pullbacks or failed retracements. CPI on September 11 is the next major event beyond this forecast horizon.

forecast.analysis: Delayed NQ is near 29,467 in a narrow observed range above the prior close. Oil and yields keep Stress extreme, but no persistent one-way extension is observed.
drivers: NQ remains close to prior settlement

news.title: Asian stocks dip as Brent holds above $100, yields near 2023 peak
Brent holds above $100 as tanker attacks deepen supply fear

forecast.analysis: European opening liquidity is the next checkpoint. Tail stays low unless NQ holds an extreme while pullbacks shrink and energy or rates align.
Once Europe is fully open, two-way NQ trade would preserve low Tail. Repeated extension after failed retracements would challenge the mixed base case.
Pre-data positioning can lift volatility without proving mean-reversion failure. Tail remains low unless pullbacks become shallow and direction becomes efficient.
drivers: Shallow pullbacks are the path warning

forecast.analysis: As U.S. participation builds, event proximity sustains Stress more than Tail. Repeated failed retracements would mark a meaningful regime change.
drivers: Failed retracements would change the regime

forecast.analysis: Within ninety minutes of PPI and claims, sensitivity rises to WATCH. A higher Tail state would require actual post-release persistence, not event proximity.
drivers: Post-release persistence is not yet observed

forecast.analysis: PPI and claims occur at 12:30 UTC. Stress reaches 100; Tail stays WATCH unless the released path holds an extreme, extends repeatedly and resists retracement.
The first post-data hour approaches the U.S. cash open. WATCH persists conditionally; block-level Tail would require failed pullbacks or aligned confirmation.
Cash-open follow-through and 14:00 UTC home-sales data form a second checkpoint. Persistent opening direction with shallow retracements would raise Tail.
After the opening sequence, Tail eases if rotation and retracement develop. Unresolved directional extension would keep WATCH-level path risk.
Late morning shifts toward mixed conditions if the opening move retraces. WATCH would persist only if directional efficiency remains unusually high.
Into midday, the base case drops below WATCH if the earlier impulse loses persistence. Renewed extension without meaningful pullbacks would invalidate it.
Midday liquidity may stay uneven, but low Tail persists absent renewed one-way extension. Energy and yields remain Stress drivers rather than Tail proof.
drivers: Energy and yields remain Stress drivers

forecast.analysis: Early afternoon stays mixed if NQ rotates instead of holding a directional extreme. A fresh failed-retracement sequence would be needed to lift Tail.
Later in the session, the base case assumes no persistent second leg. Tail would rise if a new catalyst aligns with extreme-holding and repeated extension.
drivers: Catalyst plus path confirmation would raise Tail

forecast.analysis: Late-afternoon Tail stays low if price discovery remains two-sided. A renewed break with weak retracements would raise risk above this forecast.
drivers: Weak retracements after a break would raise Tail

forecast.analysis: Into the U.S. close, low Tail depends on continued mean reversion. Closing-auction persistence near an extreme is the main conditional risk.
After the cash close, the base case assumes no persistent second leg. Thin liquidity may raise noise without automatically raising Tail.
drivers: A persistent second leg would invalidate the base case

forecast.analysis: During evening futures trade, Tail stays low if price remains rotational. Gap-like repricing with little retracement would lift the state.
Overnight Stress remains elevated, but Tail stays low unless NQ extends directionally through repeated shallow pullbacks.
drivers: Repeated shallow pullbacks would raise Tail

forecast.analysis: The overnight base case remains mixed. A sustained break near an extreme, reinforced by rates or energy, would be the main escalation condition.
drivers: Rates or energy could amplify an aligned move

forecast.analysis: As Asian liquidity develops, low Tail depends on retracements continuing to interrupt directional pushes. A one-way handoff would challenge the base case.
drivers: A one-way regional handoff would raise Tail

forecast.analysis: CPI approaches later on September 11, so anticipation can lift Stress. Tail remains low unless overnight price structure becomes persistently directional.
drivers: CPI is a later verified checkpoint
Persistent overnight direction would raise Tail

forecast.analysis: At the horizon end, macro Stress stays elevated into the pre-CPI day. Low Tail depends on two-way NQ structure rather than sustained extreme-holding.
drivers: Two-way structure would preserve low Tail

forecastDetail.comment: Observed delayed NQ is close to the prior close in a narrow range; oil and rates drive extreme Stress.
European opening liquidity is the next checkpoint; Tail rises only with extreme-holding and shrinking pullbacks.
Two-way trade preserves low Tail; repeated extension after failed retracements would challenge the mixed base case.
Pre-data positioning mainly affects Stress unless shallow pullbacks and directional efficiency emerge.
Rising U.S. participation is a checkpoint; event proximity alone does not justify block-level Tail.
WATCH reflects proximity to PPI and claims; higher Tail requires observed post-release persistence.
